output.title: Decreasing Students' Stress Through Time Management Training

scenes.narration: Bayram and Bilgel noted that student mental health is a growing global concern, asking how long alarming signs of stress will remain neglected.
scenes.layout_description: Centered minimalist drawing of a university student surrounded by light orange question marks.
scenes.visual_prompt: Simple hand-drawn black ink sketch of a university student sitting at a desk with head in hands, highlighted with a subtle yellow halo and orange question marks around them on a solid cream background (#F9F7F2).

scenes.narration: Pierceall and Keim reported that seventy-five percent of community college students perceived moderate stress, while thirteen percent reported perceiving high stress levels.
scenes.layout_description: Pie chart drawn with black ink, using orange and yellow highlights for the percentages.
scenes.visual_prompt: Minimalist hand-drawn pie chart in black line art on a cream background (#F9F7F2), with a large orange section for 75%, a small bright yellow section for 13%, and an unshaded section for 12%.

scenes.narration: Heightened stress contributes to underachievement, dropout, and unhealthy coping strategies such as drinking, smoking, and using illegal drugs, according to prior studies.
scenes.layout_description: Three sketch icons in a horizontal row connected by orange directional arrows.
scenes.visual_prompt: Black ink line art depicting a falling grade arrow, a dropping book, and warning signs, with orange arrows connecting them across a clean off-white background (#F9F7F2).

scenes.narration: Time-related demands like high workload and self-organized learning create serious problems for students, as described by Van der Meer and colleagues.
scenes.layout_description: A central illustration of a clock surrounded by stacking paper towers.
scenes.visual_prompt: Hand-drawn black ink drawing of a ticking clock with an orange outline, surrounded by neat stacks of paper highlighted with soft yellow shading on a cream background (#F9F7F2).

scenes.narration: Although time management is often recommended, Adamson and colleagues pointed out that evidence-based interventions for undergraduate students remain scarce in literature.
scenes.layout_description: A magnifying glass focused on an open textbook with orange circle accents.
scenes.visual_prompt: Minimalist black line sketch of a magnifying glass over an open study book, with an orange circle highlighting a blank section on a plain off-white background (#F9F7F2).

scenes.narration: A previous study by Häfner and colleagues prevented stress increases, but failed to show an actual stress decrease or evaluate strategy transfer.
scenes.layout_description: Split slide showing a flat line next to a rising line in black ink.
scenes.visual_prompt: Simple black ink line graph comparing two lines, where one line stays flat with a yellow highlight and the other rises, on a solid cream background (#F9F7F2).

scenes.narration: This study aimed to examine if time management training reduces stress, increases perceived control of time, and maintains effects over four weeks.
scenes.layout_description: Timeline graphic with two distinct post-training points highlighted in orange.
scenes.visual_prompt: Hand-drawn black line timeline with a starting point and two distinct milestone flags marked with bright orange dots on a cream background (#F9F7F2).

scenes.narration: Häfner and Stock described effective time management as combining time assessment, goal setting, planning, and daily monitoring activities to guide student behaviors.
scenes.layout_description: Four quadrant grid with simple line art icons and yellow highlights.
scenes.visual_prompt: Minimalist four-quadrant sketch in black ink showing a target, a calendar, a checklist, and a clock, with yellow fill on the checklist checkmarks on a cream background (#F9F7F2).

scenes.narration: Researchers assume that practicing time management increases perceived control of time, which subsequently acts as an antecedent to reduce perceived stress levels.
scenes.layout_description: Flow diagram with three black ink boxes connected by an orange arrow.
scenes.visual_prompt: Simple horizontal diagram of three drawn boxes in black ink labeled Time Management, Control of Time, and Perceived Stress, linked by a thick orange arrow on an off-white background (#F9F7F2).

scenes.narration: The authors hypothesized that training would increase control of time and decrease stress, while self-reported external demands would remain entirely unchanged.
scenes.layout_description: Three vertical indicator arrows showing direction of hypothesized movement.
scenes.visual_prompt: Hand-drawn minimalist icons showing a downward arrow in orange for stress, an upward arrow in yellow for control, and a flat horizontal arrow for demands on a cream background (#F9F7F2).

scenes.narration: The study utilized a non-equivalent dependent variable design, testing one group on both intervention-targeted variables and an uninfluenced control variable.
scenes.layout_description: A balance scale comparing experimental variables against a control variable.
scenes.visual_prompt: Sketch-style balance scale in black ink holding two variables on one side with orange highlights and one control variable on the other on a plain off-white background (#F9F7F2).

scenes.narration: Frese and colleagues stated this design rules out placebo, testing, and Hawthorne effects because trainees participate in real training without pseudo-groups.
scenes.layout_description: Quotation mark visual framing the central methodology concept.
scenes.visual_prompt: Large hand-drawn black ink quotation marks enclosing a simple shield graphic accented with bright yellow on a solid cream background (#F9F7F2).

scenes.narration: Perceived stress was measured using the tension scale, while external work commitments were measured using the demands scale as a control.
scenes.layout_description: Two side-by-side clipboard sketches with distinct headers.
scenes.visual_prompt: Two line-art clipboards drawn in black ink, one labeled for internal stress tension with an orange border and one for external demands on an off-white background (#F9F7F2).

scenes.narration: The four-hour intervention taught twenty-three students core strategies including prioritizing, defining proximal goals, daily planning, and monitoring daily task progress.
scenes.layout_description: Central clock showing 4 hours surrounded by a small student group illustration.
scenes.visual_prompt: Minimalist sketch of a group of student avatars sitting together with a large four-hour clock highlighted in yellow and orange above them on a cream background (#F9F7F2).

scenes.narration: Students reflected on tasks, set challenging deadlines, built concrete implementation intentions, and reviewed completed goals daily to overcome potential study obstacles.
scenes.layout_description: A step-by-step staircase leading upward to a flag.
scenes.visual_prompt: Hand-drawn staircase in black ink with orange arrows pointing up each step toward a flag at the top on a solid cream background (#F9F7F2).

scenes.narration: Out of forty-eight recruited German undergraduates, twenty-three students completed all three questionnaire waves, yielding a final response rate of forty-eight percent.
scenes.layout_description: Funnel diagram illustrating participant retention across measurement waves.
scenes.visual_prompt: Simple funnel drawn in black line art showing 48 icons entering at the top and 23 highlighted in yellow emerging at the bottom on an off-white background (#F9F7F2).

scenes.narration: Participants had a mean age of twenty-three point three zero years, fifty-two percent were female, and they represented diverse academic faculties.
scenes.layout_description: Minimalist demographic icons with clean text alignment.
scenes.visual_prompt: Line-art silhouettes of diverse students in black ink, with a subtle orange circle surrounding a female figure on a clean cream background (#F9F7F2).

scenes.narration: Before training, over sixty percent of the students reported having either no experience or little experience with time management strategies overall.
scenes.layout_description: Bar chart comparing student baseline experience levels.
scenes.visual_prompt: Hand-drawn horizontal bar chart in black ink with two equal top bars shaded in orange and yellow on a plain cream background (#F9F7F2).

scenes.narration: Data were collected directly before training, two weeks after, and four weeks after, ensuring all measurements occurred before final semester examinations.
scenes.layout_description: Calendar graphic showing three circled test dates.
scenes.visual_prompt: Minimalist monthly calendar page drawn in black ink, with three specific dates circled in bold orange and yellow ink on an off-white background (#F9F7F2).

scenes.narration: Trainees reported a significant increase in using time management strategies four weeks after training, confirming that training transfer occurred to some extent.
scenes.layout_description: Graph showing upward trajectory of time management strategy usage.
scenes.visual_prompt: Simple line chart drawn in black ink with a clear upward trend curve highlighted in bright orange on a solid cream background (#F9F7F2).

scenes.narration: Two weeks after training, participants reported significantly decreased perceived stress and a non-significant tendency toward increased perceived control over their time.
scenes.layout_description: Two gauge indicators showing stress drop and control tendency.
scenes.visual_prompt: Hand-drawn stress dial pointing down with an orange outline next to a control dial tilting slightly upward on a cream background (#F9F7F2).

scenes.narration: Four weeks after training, participants reported significantly lower perceived stress and significantly higher perceived control of time compared to baseline scores.
scenes.layout_description: Two prominent metric boxes with directional change arrows.
scenes.visual_prompt: Two sketch boxes in black ink; one shows a reduced stress score, and the other shows an increased control score highlighted in yellow on an off-white background (#F9F7F2).

scenes.narration: Self-reported demands showed no significant changes at two weeks or four weeks post-training, satisfying the internal validity check for this design.
scenes.layout_description: Flat line graph with a checkmark overlay.
scenes.visual_prompt: Horizontal flat line sketch in black ink staying steady across time points, with an orange checkmark drawn beside it on a cream background (#F9F7F2).

scenes.narration: Effects were more than twice as strong for students who had no or little prior experience compared to moderately experienced students.
scenes.layout_description: Comparison bar chart comparing low experience vs high experience gains.
scenes.visual_prompt: Two side-by-side bar charts in black ink, where the left bar for inexperienced students is twice as tall and filled with orange shading on a cream background (#F9F7F2).

scenes.narration: The authors suggested that daily planning and goal setting provide orientation, reducing internal tension reactions without changing external academic workload demands.
scenes.layout_description: Compass icon pointing toward a calm horizon line.
scenes.visual_prompt: Minimalist hand-drawn compass in black ink with an orange needle pointing toward a simple horizon line on an off-white background (#F9F7F2).

scenes.narration: Methodological limitations included a small sample size, a high dropout rate, and the absence of an experimental group receiving pseudo-training.
scenes.layout_description: Three bulleted caution sign icons in line art.
scenes.visual_prompt: Three sketch warning triangles in black line art with yellow filled centers arranged horizontally on a plain cream background (#F9F7F2).

scenes.narration: Time management training might benefit student well-being, though the authors emphasize that larger intervention studies are needed to establish robust conclusions.
scenes.layout_description: Closing summary graphic with a university building and lightbulb.
scenes.visual_prompt: Hand-drawn outline of a university building with a glowing yellow lightbulb suspended above it on a solid cream background (#F9F7F2).
